decisions.detail: 'Find an expression for the area of a figure whose dimensions are algebraic terms (and π where a circle is involved), and write the answer in expanded form.' Only exercise evidence (7 items); one of the two rule failures of this chapter (rule 1).
decisions.basis: ORCHESTRATOR (AI) RULING, not a human stamp and not in the auto-pass rule set: section 13.1 never demonstrates writing an area as an algebraic expression. Its teaching text is the area definition (b04117), the formula list (b04119) and WE1 (a parallelogram's area by formula, numbers only); the skill appears only in exercises (Ex13-1:2-3, Ex13-7:2, 29a), which is one evidence kind (rule 1). Each of those items substitutes algebraic lengths into the same formulas and expands the product (Chapter 1's skill), so it practises lo:g10m13s1-1-1's formulas. Same precedent as chapters 1, 5, 7 and 12 (an objective the book never demonstrates is dropped, its items placed on the objective whose taught skill they apply). Exercise-only objectives policy is open with Samuel.
